barriers.description: The research team did not record reasons for non-participation or characteristics of non-participants, leaving gaps in understanding who was excluded from study phases.
barriers.justification: Lack of data on non-participants limited the designers' ability to manage user understanding and to ensure representative recruitment for HCD activities (understand context of use and facilitate user involvement).
barriers.reference_excerpt: Reasons for non-participation and characteristics of the non-participant cohort were not recorded.

barriers.description: The community advisory board (CAB) comprised only eight members, so community input beyond those directly associated with the study came from a relatively small number of individuals.
barriers.justification: Limited stakeholder representation constrained the designers' ability to manage evolving community understanding and to facilitate broader user involvement during planning and feedback phases.
barriers.reference_excerpt: Additionally, our community advisory board included only eight members, so our community input beyond those directly associated with the study came from a relatively small number of individuals.

barriers.description: The study focused recruitment on variation in print literacy and excluded patients with cognitive disabilities or poor English proficiency, potentially missing important perspectives.
barriers.justification: Excluding these groups reduced the designers' ability to fully understand the range of user needs and contexts of use, limiting requirement specification and inclusive design decisions.
barriers.reference_excerpt: For example, patients with cognitive disabilities or with poor English proficiency may have perspectives that differ from the broader low print literacy population.  ...  we chose to focus our recruitment strategy on ensuring variation in print literacy levels.

barriers.description: Patients did not participate directly in the ideation workshop; designers relied on patient quotes and suggestions instead of real-time co-creation.
barriers.justification: Absence of direct patient participation limited facilitation of user involvement and constrained real-time integration of user feedback during ideation, affecting iteration and solution generation.
barriers.reference_excerpt: Although patients did not participate in the ideation workshop, we engaged co-creation and participatory processes [58, 59] by incorporating direct patient quotes and patient suggestions into the discussion.
